intent: First class Android 2D learning game, one Play install with all rights-cleared multimedia, 2-3 GB download, runnable offline without content downloads

distributions.pre_release_test: signed 2GB and 3GB APK install on real supported Android versions, verify ZIP/APK tooling and storage
distributions.warning: Legacy Google Play APK submissions have separate 100MB cap, not install-time PAD route

engine.game2d: Phaser, loaded only in game scenes
engine.android_shell: Capacitor 8 native Android + Kotlin custom plugins
engine.media: native media data source/Media3 or verified WebViewAssetLoader Range/seek adapter; no raw file:// assumptions
engine.game_domain_rule: NPC conversations generate learning events, game score not a YKI grade

rights: only owned, licensed, approved-to-redistribute resources can be install-time packaged

android_asset_access.PAD_install_time_source: APK assets AssetManager; fast-follow/on-demand file backed have separate behavior

game_design.scope: 2D interactive Finnish town, NPCs, scenario-based minigames and role-play

development_gates.goal: One Android NPC mission voice+text offline and playable with all four-domain paths
Google Play internal testing of >1GB synthetic install-time packs with seek and app resume
Original/rights-cleared content pack at ~2.6GB target with SHA256 & codec reports
airplane mode, WebView/video seeks, QA physical Android and memory test
Responsive Web+PWA four skills, shared Phaser game, media streaming, captions, voice and selected offline packs on Chromium/Firefox/WebKit and real mobile devices
Run same business logic tests against Web and Android media/storage adapters, same content hashes and first-attempt policies

platform_strategy.model: One cross-platform app, shared strict TypeScript domain and React UI; Phaser world shared on Android and Web

web.kind: Responsive installable PWA and desktop/mobile browser app
web.deploy: Static frontend via CDN, versioned content manifests, media streamed via HTTPS
web.media: Stream licensed audio/video and subtitles; optional selective offline downloads controlled by learner; no compulsory 2–3 GB first browser visit
web.local_data: IndexedDB/Dexie for user progress; Cache Storage/OPFS for selected offline media only with quota checks
web.permission: User gesture and microphone permission; unsupported codecs and iOS Safari fallback
web.offline: PWA shell plus user-selected cached lessons. Non-downloaded media unavailable offline
web.updates: Defer service worker activation until exam attempt ends

android.kind: Capacitor native Android shell with shared Web UI and Phaser canvas
android.deploy: Google Play AAB plus install-time PAD bundles, no mandatory media download after first launch
android.media: Kotlin/native player and asset provider; no 2–3GB duplication into IndexedDB
android.local_data: IndexedDB/Dexie for progress; optional consented local learner audio
android.offline: All release media with redistribution rights bundled and accessible in airplane mode
android.updates: Versioned native asset packs; do not activate new content during an active exam

sync.source: Later Supabase Postgres/Auth and API in EU
sync.conflict_policy: Append-only idempotent attempt events; no silent last-write-wins on running exam
sync.identity: Same task ID, version and content hash on both platforms

strict_parity: Same four learning skills and two modes
Shared story/quest logic and Phaser scenes
Same content keys, lexicon, adaptive SRS and scoring policy
Exam provides no hints on either platform
Distinct offline delivery policy on Web vs Android
